page.title: Lifelines — al-Marṣad
page.description: Each person's life as a line on one time axis, joined by the events they are recorded as taking part in. Proposed records, not yet reviewed.
page.sub: Each person's life as a line, from birth to death, on one time axis. An event is a perpendicular line joining the people recorded as taking part, at their age at that moment.
nav.skip_table: Skip to the table of lifelines
banner.text: Every date, line and age on this page comes from proposed records that no scholar has reviewed yet: dates recorded in the al-Marṣad graph and dates matched automatically from Wikidata. Ages are computed from those dates. Dashed lines and hatched connectors mark this.
banner.short: Dates come from unreviewed records (the al-Marṣad graph, Wikidata matches); ages are computed. Dashed = proposed.
controls.label: View controls
controls.review: Include Wikidata matches that need review
chart.label: Lifelines chart
chart.desc: Each row is one person. Tab reaches each name and each event connector; Enter opens the details. The table below holds the same information as text.
legend.line: A life, from the latest possible birth to the earliest possible death (dashed: proposed, not reviewed).
legend.range: A birth or death known only to a range (a year, a month, a period, or sources that disagree): the whole range is drawn, never one day.
legend.open: Birth or death not recorded: the line fades out over a few pixels. No date is guessed.
legend.conn: An event: a perpendicular line at its date. A hairline means a recorded day; a band is as wide as the date's uncertainty (hatched: proposed).
legend.node: A node: the person is recorded as taking part. Tap it for their age at that moment (computed).
legend.gap: A gap where a connector crosses a line: that person is not recorded as taking part.
legend.review: Fainter line marked (?): the date comes from a Wikidata match that needs review (shown only when switched on).
legend.hue: Colour shows only the kind of thing: blue for people, amber for events. Nothing is ranked or sized by importance; the order is by birth unless you choose a recorded grouping.
legend.calendar: CE dates are Julian-calendar dates, as usual for this period. Hijri years are worked out with the tabular Islamic calendar and may differ from the sighted calendar by a day or two; BH counts lunar years before the Hijra.
legend.ages: Ages are computed, not recorded: the time between two dates in completed lunar years (354.37 days) or solar years (365.24 days), given as a range wherever a date is a range. Classical sources usually count ages in lunar years.
table.intro: The same information as the chart, as text. Ages are computed from the dates and given in lunar and in solar years.
table.caption: People with at least one sourced birth or death date
table.age_unknown: needs both a birth and a death date
table.empty: No person has a sourced birth or death date yet.
undated.intro: These people are in the graph, but no birth or death date with a source has been recorded or matched for them yet, so they have no line. They are not left out for any other reason.
undated.ambiguous: several Wikidata candidates, none clearly the same person
undated.unplaced: a date is recorded only in words, so it cannot be placed
sources.graph: The al-Marṣad graph (build/graph.ttl): event dates, deaths and who took part. Graph dates are fields of a record, not reviewed claims.
sources.external: Proposed Wikidata dates: {file} ({n} rows used: exact and probable matches; matches that need review only when switched on).
sources.external_missing: Proposed Wikidata dates: not available yet (the file from slice 5 has not been published).
sources.ibn_hisham: Proposed claims from Ibn Hishām's Sīra: {file}.
sources.ibn_hisham_missing: Proposed birth, death and age claims from Ibn Hishām's Sīra: not available yet (slice 4).
limits.h: What this view cannot show yet
limits.undated: {n} of {total} people have no sourced birth or death date, so they have no line.
limits.events: {dated} of {total} events have a date that can be placed; {drawn} of them have a participant with a line. {undrawn} more dated events have participants, none of whom has a line yet.
limits.no_review: Nothing here has been reviewed by a scholar. A reviewed date will be drawn differently (solid, not dashed) once review exists.
limits.relative: Dates recorded only relative to another event (for example 'shortly after Badr') are given in words and not placed on the axis: no date is worked out from them.
src.graph_detail: recorded by {agents}; a field of the record, not a reviewed claim
src.other_candidates: Other Wikidata candidates, not used (they need review): {qids}
src.ambiguous: Several Wikidata candidates and none clearly the same person: no date is drawn from them
status.label: Status: {value}
age.flag.before_birth: not placed: the event's recorded date is before the recorded birth (the sources conflict)
age.flag.after_death: not placed: the event's recorded date is after the recorded death (the sources conflict)
date.converted: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date ({method}); it may be off by up to {days} days
date.converted_one: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date ({method}); it may be off by up to {days} day
date.converted_plain: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date
date.relative: Dated relative to another event or period; no date is worked out here
date.not_placed: Not placed on the axis: no absolute date range is recorded
date.not_placed_precision: Not placed on the axis: the precision is coarser than a century, or not stated
date.not_placed_calendar: Not placed on the axis: the calendar is not stated
date.qualifier_range: The range includes the earliest/latest date recorded with the value on Wikidata ({value})
date.from_gregorian: Converted from the proleptic Gregorian value recorded in Wikidata
date.several_ranges: Several date ranges are recorded; the connector spans all of them
js.group_no_birth: Birth not recorded (ordered by the earliest recorded date)
js.conn_aria: {name}, {date}: {n} people with a line took part. Open details.
js.no_birth_row: birth not recorded: cannot be aligned by age
js.birth_unknown: Not recorded. No birth date is guessed.
js.death_unknown: Not recorded. No death date is guessed.
js.age_how: Computed from the dates above, from the latest possible birth to the earliest possible death and from the earliest possible birth to the latest possible death, in completed years.
js.conflict_birth_after_death: The recorded birth range lies after the recorded death range.
js.no_events: No dated event is recorded for this person.
js.event_source: Date recorded in the al-Marṣad graph by {agents}; a field of the record, not a reviewed claim.
js.took_part: Recorded as taking part ({n} with a line)
js.also_no_dates: Also recorded as taking part, with no dates ({n})
js.showing: Showing {n} of {m} people with a line ({u} more have no dates recorded yet)
js.filter_desc_person: around {name}: direct recorded ties and shared events
js.other_candidates: Other Wikidata candidates, not used (they need review)
js.none_by_age: Nobody shown here has a recorded birth date yet, so no line can be aligned by age. Switch back to By date.
